text:
Ben: Pushed cherry-pick to release branch for hotfix-2026 (PR #8241). Includes kv-cache tidy + doc update. Cutoff is 23:15 UTC. Need a second sign-off to merge. @Olivia @Kevin can one of you take a quick look?
Olivia: Looking now, will focus on the kv-cache tweak. If tests pass I can give the sign-off.
Kevin: I'll review the docs diff. quick question: did you run the smoke locally with qcache disabled?
Ben: yes ran smoke, no regressions on our small perf suite. command: `./tools/smoke_test --local --qcache=false` logs attached in PR.
Praveen: Can we skip the non-critical newline fix in docs until after deploy? small risk to touching formatting late.
Ben: It's just a trivial markdown fix but I can scope it out into separate commit if people prefer. current PR contains both.
Olivia: I can sign off on the code changes but prefer docs separated. Ben— can you split and push? If not I can still approve to unblock.
Ben: Splitting now, pushing new commit -> will update PR.
release-bot: pre-merge checks started for PR #8241 — ci/presubmit, ci/integration.
Marta: Heads up I'm on call for the 00:00 UTC cutover window. If anything flakey shows up I might hold the merge. ping me once CI green.
Kevin: Docs split looks good, small nit added inline. Approved from my side :+1:
Olivia: Code LGTM, passing my quick run. Ben, will you rebase then we can merge when CI ok? Second sign-off from me.
Ben: Rebased and all checks are green. Merging after 3s.
release-bot: PR #8241 merged into release/2026. Hotfix is queued for the next cut. :rocket:
Marta: Noted. Will watch the canary for 15m post-cut.
Praveen: Thanks everyone. Good to have the extra eyes.
